user.title: Device Setup
user.description: Configure your Tasmota IR air conditioner connection.

data_description.vendor: The IR protocol vendor (e.g., SAMSUNG_AC, ELECTRA_AC, FUJITSU_AC, MITSUBISHI_AC).
data_description.command_topic: MQTT topic for sending IR commands. Usually cmnd/'{device}'/irhvac.
data_description.state_topic: Primary MQTT topic for receiving AC state updates. Use tele/'{device}'/RESULT to capture all IR signals (including physical remote).
data_description.state_topic_2: Optional secondary MQTT state topic. Use stat/'{device}'/RESULT to also capture IR transmission confirmations. Subscribes to both topics if set.
data_description.availability_topic: MQTT topic for device online/offline status. Leave blank to auto-derive from command topic (tele/'{device}'/LWT).
data_description.mqtt_delay: Delay in seconds between MQTT commands. Use when operating multiple devices to stagger high-current peaks.

climate.title: Climate Settings
climate.description: Configure temperature ranges, modes, and fan settings. All fields have sensible defaults.

data_description.celsius_mode: Temperature unit for IR commands sent to the AC. Most AC units use Celsius internally ('on') even if your HA or remote displays Fahrenheit. Only change to 'off' if your specific AC model requires Fahrenheit IR commands.
data_description.ignore_off_temp: When the AC is turned off via remote, some devices report the lowest temperature. Enable to keep showing the last target temperature instead.
data_description.keep_mode_when_off: Keep the last HVAC mode when turning off. Required for MITSUBISHI_AC, ECOCLIM, and similar devices.
data_description.away_temp: Temperature to use when Away preset is active. Leave blank to disable the Away preset.
data_description.supported_fan_speeds: Note: auto_max/max_high are for devices where the remote shows max but Tasmota reports high, and auto which is actually max.
data_description.supported_preset_modes: Vendor-specific preset modes. Select the presets your unit supports. Leave empty if your unit has no special presets. Custom values can be typed in.

advanced.title: Advanced Settings & Sensors
advanced.description: Configure default modes, swing positions, toggle properties, and external sensors.

data_description.pi_enabled: Enable the PI+feedforward controller for automatic temperature regulation. When enabled, the next step will let you configure PI parameters.
data_description.has_set_vertical_vane: Enable if your unit has a button to cycle the vertical vane to a fixed position. Creates a button entity.
data_description.has_set_horizontal_vane: Enable if your unit has a button to cycle the horizontal vane to a fixed position. Creates a button entity.
data_description.default_quiet_mode: Quiet mode via IRHVAC JSON command. Some vendors ignore this — use vendor-specific presets instead if available.
data_description.default_turbo_mode: Turbo mode via IRHVAC JSON command. Some vendors ignore this — use vendor-specific presets instead if available.
data_description.default_econo_mode: Economy mode via IRHVAC JSON command. Some vendors ignore this — use vendor-specific presets instead if available.
data_description.hvac_model: AC model identifier. Use -1 for auto-detection.
data_description.toggle_list: Properties that don't retain the On state. Set this if your AC has toggle-only controls (pressing the button toggles between on and off rather than setting a specific state).
data_description.special_mode: Mode to enter for special functions like automatic cleaning after operation. Leave blank to disable.
data_description.temperature_sensor: External temperature sensor entity for more accurate room temperature readings.
data_description.power_sensor: Binary sensor or sensor that indicates whether the AC unit is powered on.

pi_controller.title: PI Controller
pi_controller.description: Configure the PI+feedforward controller for automatic temperature regulation.

data_description.pi_enabled: Enable the PI+feedforward controller for automatic temperature regulation.
data_description.pi_kp: Proportional gain. Higher values react faster to temperature errors but may overshoot.
data_description.pi_ki: Integral gain. Eliminates steady-state error over time.
data_description.pi_deadband: Temperature range around setpoint where no adjustments are made.
data_description.outdoor_temp_sensor: Outdoor temperature sensor for feedforward compensation. Without this, the PI controller runs on proportional + integral only (no weather-based offset). With it, the controller auto-learns optimal setpoint offsets for different outdoor temperatures.
data_description.pi_ff_heat_reference: Outdoor temperature at which no feedforward heating offset is needed.
data_description.pi_ff_heat_slope: Degrees of heating offset per degree below the heat reference.
data_description.pi_ff_cool_reference: Outdoor temperature at which no feedforward cooling offset is needed.
data_description.pi_ff_cool_slope: Degrees of cooling offset per degree above the cool reference.
data_description.pi_setpoint_weight: 2-DOF PI setpoint weighting. At 1.0 (default), P reacts fully to setpoint changes. At 0.0, P only reacts to disturbances. Try 0.5 for less overshoot on setpoint changes.

disturbance_inputs_add.title: Add Disturbance Input
disturbance_inputs_add.description: Define an external disturbance source. Boolean entities (binary_sensor, input_boolean) use the default bias when active. Numeric entities (sensor, input_number) use their value multiplied by the gain as bias.

data_description.disturbance_name: Display name for this disturbance source (e.g., 'Pellet Stove', 'Bunkroom Door').
data_description.disturbance_entity: Entity to watch. Binary sensors use the default bias when on. Numeric sensors use their value × gain as bias in °C.
data_description.disturbance_suppress: Suppress feedforward auto-learning when this entity is active. Prevents the controller from learning bad offsets during atypical conditions.
data_description.disturbance_default_bias: Bias in °C applied when a boolean entity is 'on'. Negative = reduce HP effort (e.g., pellet stove heating), positive = increase HP effort (e.g., door open). Ignored for numeric entities.
data_description.disturbance_gain: Multiplier for numeric entity values. The bias applied is entity_value × gain. Use 1.0 if the entity already outputs °C directly (e.g., a template sensor). Ignored for boolean entities.

disturbance_inputs_edit.title: Edit Disturbance Input
disturbance_inputs_edit.description: Select a disturbance input to edit.

disturbance_inputs_edit_form.title: Edit Disturbance Input
disturbance_inputs_edit_form.description: Update the settings for this disturbance input.

ir_actions_add.title: Add IR Action
ir_actions_add.description: Define a new IR action. Buttons send an IR code when pressed. Presets show in the preset dropdown with state tracking.

data_description.ir_action_name: Display name for the action (e.g., 'Powerful', 'Filter Clean').
data_description.ir_action_type: Button: one-shot action, no state. Preset: shows in preset dropdown with state tracking.
data_description.ir_action_code: Raw IR code string to send via Tasmota IRSend (e.g., 'raw,0,3324,1574,...').
data_description.ir_action_exit_code: IR code to send when deactivating this preset. Leave empty if the preset toggles with the same code.
data_description.ir_action_auto_clear: Automatically deactivate this preset after N seconds (e.g., 1200 for 20 min). 0 = stay active until manually changed.
data_description.ir_action_pause_pi: Pause the PI controller while this preset is active. Use for modes that override normal temperature control.

outdoor_sensor_not_found.title: Outdoor temperature sensor not found
outdoor_sensor_not_found.description: The PI controller is configured to use outdoor temperature sensor `{entity_id}`, but this entity does not exist in Home Assistant. Feedforward compensation will not work until this is resolved.

disturbance_entity_not_found.title: Disturbance input entity not found
disturbance_entity_not_found.description: The disturbance input '{name}' references entity `{entity_id}`, but this entity does not exist. Suppress/bias from this input will not work until the entity is available.

temp_sensor_not_found.title: Temperature sensor not found
temp_sensor_not_found.description: The climate entity is configured with temperature sensor `{entity_id}`, but this entity does not exist. PI control and accurate temperature display require this sensor.
